why: Removes the cycle refusal in `longestDependencyChain` in the way a real bug would -- a bound nothing reaches rather than a deleted line. A longest path is undefined on a cyclic graph, and #437 states that cycles must fail generation or display an unmistakable diagnostic and never masquerade as a valid DAG. Under the mutation the function returns a confident, plausible-looking chain instead of nothing.
killedBy: frontier: the longest dependency chain, which is not a critical path refuses to answer at all when the snapshot reports a cycle
